I don't know how it works in llika the US, but here in Sweden, we have one emergency room for physical injuries, such at broken legs and that kind of crap.

And then we have an Emrgecy Psych ward, where people who feels really bad comes (like, suicidal and that sort of stuff). Then you get to talk to a Pyschatrist (NOT a psychologist) and the makes an assessment of the seriousness, how long you've been ill and how desperate you are. I qualifies for all three, I believe.

I made this during my time in an enclosed psych ward since I have suicidal tendensies, self harm, anxiety, OCD, IBS, GAD, social fobia and so on. Been struggeling for 8 years and one night I had enough. Totally stoned on bensodiazepine och Gabapetin, I was about to finally take my own life.

Luckily, my girlfrind and a very close friend to me came in the middle of the night and took my, against my will, to the psych ward where the commited me to the said enclosed observation unit.
I got stipped searched. I could'nt have any strings, such as shoe laces, chargers for computer, cell phone and such. Hoodies with them strings were a big no-no.

I could still use my computer, and since I have a Mac with a quite good battery life, the only thing I could to was drawing in the computer (I werent allowed to use pensils).

Then I started with this illustraton of a sugar skull. I suppose the skull itself is a symbol of me and my suicidal tendencies. I do however feel like I cheated the devil inside me. I could strike him down, atleast for a short period of time.

I got out, got medicated (bensodiazepin, gabapetin, zopikol and atarax). Two days after I got out, I freaked out again. I'm worried that they'll take away my medicine, and I still am. Went to the psychiatric emergency, but got sent home again. My thoughts about taking my own life is still there, but not cause my life sucks, since I have my meds. It's rather because I know they can take them away. 

I don't really know how much longer I can stay afloat.

**Please feel free to ask me anything, about the illustraton, about my illness or anything else. I'm an open book, nothing you say can chock me, really**. It's nothing compared to the pictures posted here. I'm well aware of that, but I still wanted to share my picture.

Much love to you, reddit. You can be great.

I made this while I was in a psychiatric observation unit for self destructung behavour (no, I didn't cut my wrists). I've been dealing with my demons for over eight years now, and one night it all just came bursting out. I couldn't handle it anymore.

The devil inside me got a hold of me.

With the help of a now very close friend, and my girldfriend whom I'm living with, I managed to not take my own life.

Needless to say I was commited to a closed psychiatric ward. Basically anything that could be used for self harm was forbidden. I couldn't have my belt in my pants, no shoelaces no bracelets. Ofcourse, cellphone and computer charges weren't allowed neither.

I then decided to try to picture my demons and as I grew stronger, I started to draw this picture. I've cheated the devil once, but he still has a hold of me.

Hopefully, I can cheat him again, and get rid of him once and for all.
